tools.name: weatherbit_subscription_usage
tools.description: Read quota counters and reset times. Uses one standard Weatherbit request. No weather lookup is made.

tools.name: weatherbit_current_weather
tools.description: Get the latest weather conditions for a coordinate. Consumes Weatherbit quota; requires a commercial-use subscription for this integration.

tools.name: weatherbit_daily_forecast
tools.description: Get up to 16 daily forecasts (temperature, precipitation, wind and conditions). Consumes Weatherbit quota; available horizon depends on your plan.

tools.name: weatherbit_hourly_forecast
tools.description: Get up to 240 hourly forecasts. Consumes Weatherbit quota; requires the corresponding commercial plan.

tools.name: weatherbit_minutely_forecast
tools.description: Get the 60-minute precipitation forecast for a coordinate. Consumes Weatherbit quota; requires the corresponding commercial plan.

tools.name: weatherbit_daily_history
tools.description: Read daily historical weather over at most 31 days, end date exclusive. Historical API quota can count multiple requests for the date range. Requires a historical-data subscription.

tools.name: weatherbit_current_air_quality
tools.description: Read current AQI and pollutant concentrations. Consumes Weatherbit quota; requires air-quality API access (Business/Enterprise).

tools.name: weatherbit_air_quality_forecast
tools.description: Read up to 72 hourly AQI and pollutant forecasts. Consumes Weatherbit quota; requires air-quality API access (Business/Enterprise).

tools.name: weatherbit_agriculture_forecast
tools.description: Read the 8-day agriculture forecast including soil and evapotranspiration fields. Consumes Weatherbit quota; requires agriculture API access (Business/Enterprise).

tools.name: weatherbit_agriculture_history
tools.description: Read daily or hourly agriculture history over at most 31 days (7 for hourly), end date exclusive. Consumes historical API quota; requires agriculture API access.

tools.name: weatherbit_energy_forecast
tools.description: Read degree-day and irradiance forecasts. Consumes Weatherbit quota; requires energy API access (Business/Enterprise). Optional temperature threshold; the vendor default is 18 C.

tools.name: weatherbit_energy_history
tools.description: Read historical degree-day and irradiance data, end date exclusive, at most 31 days (7 for hourly). Consumes historical API quota; requires energy API access.
